lblName: HADB, high-angle dive bombing: run in at height to the pull-up point (PUP), roll in and dive steeply onto the target. The Mode knob to the right picks what the right half of the page shows.
lblSelections: Selections: the target steerpoint (TGT STPT), the bomb and the Extra Info knob. HADB always measures the DED lines from the target (VRP reference).
lblProfile: Profile: a drawing of the attack, and the map around the target with every point of it.
lblIngressData: Ingress Data: the sliders for the run-in to the pull-up point: speed, G, turn direction, VRP to PUP distance and ingress altitude.
lblReleaseData: Release Data: the sliders for the dive: dive angle, release speed, release height and tracking time.
lblHeadings: Headings Data: the angle off and the attack heading, which set the approach heading and where the pull-up point lies.
lblExtraInfo2: Extra Info: true airspeed at release, the MAP distance (where tracking starts), the bomb's range and the aim-off distance, worked out from your sliders.
lblDeliveryMode: The bombing mode to use in the jet for this attack: CCIP (the HUD shows where the bombs will hit; release when it is on the target) or CCRP (designate the target; the jet releases as you fly the steering line).
lblMode: Mode knob: Selections (target and choices), Profile (drawing and map) or DED Data (the figures for the jet). A click on it turns it one step on; right-click turns it back.
lblShowProfile: Turns the Mode knob straight to Profile: the drawing of the attack and the map around the target.
lblHideSelections: Turns the Mode knob straight to Selections: the target steerpoint, the bomb and the Extra Info knob.
lblShowSelections: Turns the Mode knob straight to DED Data: the figures for the jet's DED, and whether the target shows in the HUD.
pnlSelections_Up: Mode knob: Selections (target and choices), Profile (drawing and map) or DED Data (the figures for the jet). A click on it turns it one step on; right-click turns it back.
pnlSelections_Middle: Mode knob: Selections (target and choices), Profile (drawing and map) or DED Data (the figures for the jet). A click on it turns it one step on; right-click turns it back.
pnlSelections_Down: Mode knob: Selections (target and choices), Profile (drawing and map) or DED Data (the figures for the jet). A click on it turns it one step on; right-click turns it back.
lblIngressSpeed: Ingress Speed: your calibrated airspeed at the VRP and through the turn in, 300 to 550 kts in steps of 10. With the G it sets the turn radius, and so where the PUP lies.
lblAttackHdgVal: Attack Heading: your heading in the dive at the target, 0 to 360° true. Click N, E, S or W under the slider for 0, 90, 180 or 270.
lblPullingGs: Pulling G's: the G of your turn in at the pull-up point, 2 to 6. With the Ingress Speed it sets the turn radius.
lblAngleOffVal: Angle Off: how far you turn at the pull-up point, from the approach heading onto the attack heading, 0 to 90°. Click 0, 30, 60 or 90 under the slider to set it.
lblTurnToTarget: Turn To Target: which way you turn at the pull-up point onto the attack heading, left or right. It sets the side the VRP and PUP lie on, and the Approach Heading.
lblVRPtoVRPPUP: VRP to PUP dist: the leg from the VRP to the pull-up point, 1 to 5 nm.
lblAdvIngAlt: Ingress Alt: the altitude to fly at the VRP and the pull-up point, feet above sea level: the release height, the height lost tracking and rolling in, and the ground under the target.
lblAdvIngAltVal: Ingress Alt: the altitude to fly at the VRP and the pull-up point, feet above sea level: the release height, the height lost tracking and rolling in, and the ground under the target.
lblE: Sets the attack heading to east, 90°.
lblS: Sets the attack heading to south, 180°.
lblW: Sets the attack heading to west, 270°.
trbIngrSpd: Ingress Speed: your calibrated airspeed at the VRP and through the turn in, 300 to 550 kts in steps of 10. With the G it sets the turn radius, and so where the PUP lies.
lblN360: Sets the attack heading to north, 360°.
lblIngrCasVal: Ingress Speed: your calibrated airspeed at the VRP and through the turn in, 300 to 550 kts in steps of 10. With the G it sets the turn radius, and so where the PUP lies.
lblN: Sets the attack heading to north, 0°.
trbG: Pulling G's: the G of your turn in at the pull-up point, 2 to 6. With the Ingress Speed it sets the turn radius.
trbHeading: Attack Heading: your heading in the dive at the target, 0 to 360° true. Click N, E, S or W under the slider for 0, 90, 180 or 270.
lblVrpToPupVal: VRP to PUP dist: the leg from the VRP to the pull-up point, 1 to 5 nm.
trbAngleOff: Angle Off: how far you turn at the pull-up point, from the approach heading onto the attack heading, 0 to 90°. Click 0, 30, 60 or 90 under the slider to set it.
lblGVal: Pulling G's: the G of your turn in at the pull-up point, 2 to 6. With the Ingress Speed it sets the turn radius.
lblTrackingTimeVal: Tracking Time: seconds you track the target in the dive before release, 1 to 10. More time moves the roll-in further out and higher.
trbVrpToPup: VRP to PUP dist: the leg from the VRP to the pull-up point, 1 to 5 nm.
trbTrackingTime: Tracking Time: seconds you track the target in the dive before release, 1 to 10. More time moves the roll-in further out and higher.
trbTurn: Turn To Target: which way you turn at the pull-up point onto the attack heading, left or right. It sets the side the VRP and PUP lie on, and the Approach Heading.
lblRelCasVal: Release Speed: your calibrated airspeed at release, 300 to 550 kts in steps of 10. It sets the TAS at release, and so the bomb range.
lblTurnVal: Turn To Target: which way you turn at the pull-up point onto the attack heading, left or right. It sets the side the VRP and PUP lie on, and the Approach Heading.
trbReleaseSpd: Release Speed: your calibrated airspeed at release, 300 to 550 kts in steps of 10. It sets the TAS at release, and so the bomb range.
lblReleaseHeightVal: Release Height: feet above the target at release, up to 15,000; the lowest follows the dive angle. OA1 sits at the release point at this height.
trbReleaseHeight: Release Height: feet above the target at release, up to 15,000; the lowest follows the dive angle. OA1 sits at the release point at this height.
lblDiveAngleVal: Dive Angle: the dive at release, 10 to 45°. On a multiple of 5 it also sets the lowest Release Height: 1,500 ft up to 20°, 2,000 at 25°, 3,000 at 30 to 40°, 4,000 at 45°.
trbDiveAngle: Dive Angle: the dive at release, 10 to 45°. On a multiple of 5 it also sets the lowest Release Height: 1,500 ft up to 20°, 2,000 at 25°, 3,000 at 30 to 40°, 4,000 at 45°.
lblApproachHedVal: Approach Heading: the heading you fly from the VRP to the pull-up point, before the turn: the attack heading turned back by the Angle Off.
lblApproachHed: Approach Heading: the heading you fly from the VRP to the pull-up point, before the turn: the attack heading turned back by the Angle Off.
lblAngleOffInput: Angle Off: how far you turn at the pull-up point, from the approach heading onto the attack heading, 0 to 90°. Click 0, 30, 60 or 90 under the slider to set it.
lblAttackHed: Attack Heading: your heading in the dive at the target, 0 to 360° true. Click N, E, S or W under the slider for 0, 90, 180 or 270.
lblTrackingTime: Tracking Time: seconds you track the target in the dive before release, 1 to 10. More time moves the roll-in further out and higher.
lblReleaseHeight: Release Height: feet above the target at release, up to 15,000; the lowest follows the dive angle. OA1 sits at the release point at this height.
lblSpeed: Release Speed: your calibrated airspeed at release, 300 to 550 kts in steps of 10. It sets the TAS at release, and so the bomb range.
lblDiveAngle: Dive Angle: the dive at release, 10 to 45°. On a multiple of 5 it also sets the lowest Release Height: 1,500 ft up to 20°, 2,000 at 25°, 3,000 at 30 to 40°, 4,000 at 45°.
lblZoomText: Zoom: how much of the theater the map shows around the target, from about 8 nm across (left, 100%) to about 80 nm (right, 0%).
trbZoom: Zoom: how much of the theater the map shows around the target, from about 8 nm across (left, 100%) to about 80 nm (right, 0%).
lblZoom: Zoom: how much of the theater the map shows around the target, from about 8 nm across (left, 100%) to about 80 nm (right, 0%).
btnPPTnr: Show PPT Nr / Hide PPT Nr: writes each pre-planned threat's number beside its ring on the map, or takes them off. The threats are your cartridge's.
Panel1: The map's key: the target a red square, the VRP a blue circle, the pull-up point (PUP) a magenta ring, OA1 and OA2 green triangles; the white line is the run-in the jet flies, dotted past the target to OA2.
btnSaveMap: Saves this map as a JPEG on the BMS PC: a Save window opens on the SavedMaps folder (WDP's own, when WDP is on the PC), named HADB.jpg.
picSatView: The attack drawn on the theater map round the target, as every map draws it: target red square, VRP blue circle, PUP magenta ring, OA1 and OA2 green triangles, the run-in line; your route with its numbers, threats in red rings; the foot names the attack and the TGT STPT.
picProfile: Falcas's drawing of the dive for your turn direction.
btnSaveDTC: Writes the four DED lines (TGT-TO-VRP, TGT-TO-PUP, OA1, OA2) into your cartridge's nav offsets and saves the cartridge now. The VIP lines are cleared. Once saved, the DataCard's Delivery section becomes this attack, so the card and the cartridge agree; a save that fails leaves the card as it was.
lblTASval: True airspeed at release, in knots, for the Release Speed at the release height.
lblTAS: True airspeed at release, in knots, for the Release Speed at the release height.
lblAODval: Aim Off Dist: feet past the target where your dive line meets the ground; OA2 goes there. Hold the flight path marker on it in the dive.
lblAOD: Aim Off Dist: feet past the target where your dive line meets the ground; OA2 goes there. Hold the flight path marker on it in the dive.
lblBombrangeVAl: BombRange: feet the bomb travels along the ground from release to impact. OA1 is laid this far back from the target.
lblMAPVal: MAP: feet from the target along the ground where you roll out in the dive and start tracking: the bomb range plus the ground covered while tracking.
lblMAP: MAP: feet from the target along the ground where you roll out in the dive and start tracking: the bomb range plus the ground covered while tracking.
lblBombRange: BombRange: feet the bomb travels along the ground from release to impact. OA1 is laid this far back from the target.
lblTheWheel: The wheel: the circle round the target on which the pull-up point lies, at its height, from which you can roll in from any side. Shown with the Extra Info knob on Hide.
lblWheelElv: Elevation: the pull-up point's height above the target, in feet (the Ingress Alt without the ground).
lblWheelElevation: Elevation: the pull-up point's height above the target, in feet (the Ingress Alt without the ground).
lblSlantRangeNm: Slantrange: the straight-line distance from the pull-up point to the target, in feet and nm.
lblSlantRangeFeet: Slantrange: the straight-line distance from the pull-up point to the target, in feet and nm.
lblSlantRange: Slantrange: the straight-line distance from the pull-up point to the target, in feet and nm.
lblWheelRad: Radius: feet from the target to the pull-up point along the ground: the MAP plus one turn radius.
lblWheelRadius: Radius: feet from the target to the pull-up point along the ground: the MAP plus one turn radius.
lblPUPnmName: The same range in nautical miles.
lblPUPnm: The same range in nautical miles.
lblVRPnmName: The same range in nautical miles.
lblVRPnm: The same range in nautical miles.
lblOA2nmName: The same range in nautical miles.
lblOA1nmName: The same range in nautical miles.
lblOA1nm: The same range in nautical miles.
lblOA2nm: The same range in nautical miles.
lblDEDData: The jet's DED (data entry display) nav-offset pages as they will read after Save to DTC: true bearings, ranges in feet, ELEVs in feet above sea level (0 = ground level). Every ELEV can be typed: click or tap its figure.
lblTargetHUDval: YES (green) when at release the target is under 260 mils (about 15°) below your flight path, so it is still in the HUD; NO (red) when it is further down.
lblTargetHUD: YES (green) when at release the target is under 260 mils (about 15°) below your flight path, so it is still in the HUD; NO (red) when it is further down.
pnlDEDoa1: DEST OA1: offset aimpoint 1, a point the jet marks for you: the release point, the bomb range back from the target along the attack, at the release height.
lblOA1elv: This line's ELEV, in feet above sea level; 0 means ground level wherever the point is. A dotted frame is the page's own figure: click or tap to type yours (the frame turns solid), clear it to go back. Save to DTC writes what shows.
pnlDEDoa2: DEST OA2: offset aimpoint 2: the aim-off point past the target, where your dive line meets the ground. ELEV 0 means ground level.
lblOA2elv: This line's ELEV, in feet above sea level; 0 means ground level wherever the point is. A dotted frame is the page's own figure: click or tap to type yours (the frame turns solid), clear it to go back. Save to DTC writes what shows.
pnlDEDvrp: TGT-TO-VRP: true bearing and range in feet from the target steerpoint (the number) to the VRP, and the altitude to fly there. HADB always plans from a VRP.
lblVRPelv: This line's ELEV, in feet above sea level; 0 means ground level wherever the point is. A dotted frame is the page's own figure: click or tap to type yours (the frame turns solid), clear it to go back. Save to DTC writes what shows.
pnlDEDvrppup: TGT-TO-PUP: the pull-up point, where you turn in and roll into the dive, by true bearing, range in feet and ELEV from the target steerpoint.
lblVRPPUPelv: This line's ELEV, in feet above sea level; 0 means ground level wherever the point is. A dotted frame is the page's own figure: click or tap to type yours (the frame turns solid), clear it to go back. Save to DTC writes what shows.
lblTGT_EW: The target's latitude and longitude (degrees, minutes), from the TGT STPT's position. Hidden while the theater is not known or the steerpoint has no position.
lblTGT_NS: The target's latitude and longitude (degrees, minutes), from the TGT STPT's position. Hidden while the theater is not known or the steerpoint has no position.
lblIP_elv: The altitude the IP's steerpoint carries in the mission, in feet: for a route point, the height planned there, not the ground.
lblIP_E: HADB plans from a VRP only, so it has no IP: these lines stay hidden.
lblIP_N: HADB plans from a VRP only, so it has no IP: these lines stay hidden.
lblTGT_elv: Ground under the target, feet above sea level: what you typed, else BMS's terrain, else your cartridge's target point (0 if none is known). Click or tap the framed figure to type yours; clear it to go back. Every ELEV stands on it.
lblTGT_E: The target's latitude and longitude (degrees, minutes), from the TGT STPT's position. Hidden while the theater is not known or the steerpoint has no position.
lblTGT_N: The target's latitude and longitude (degrees, minutes), from the TGT STPT's position. Hidden while the theater is not known or the steerpoint has no position.
lblIPelv: The altitude the IP's steerpoint carries in the mission, in feet: for a route point, the height planned there, not the ground.
lblTGTelv: Ground under the target, feet above sea level: what you typed, else BMS's terrain, else your cartridge's target point (0 if none is known). Click or tap the framed figure to type yours; clear it to go back. Every ELEV stands on it.
lblIPelv2: The altitude the IP's steerpoint carries in the mission, in feet: for a route point, the height planned there, not the ground.
lblTGTelv2: Ground under the target, feet above sea level: what you typed, else BMS's terrain, else your cartridge's target point (0 if none is known). Click or tap the framed figure to type yours; clear it to go back. Every ELEV stands on it.
lblIP_EW: HADB plans from a VRP only, so it has no IP: these lines stay hidden.
lblIP_NS: HADB plans from a VRP only, so it has no IP: these lines stay hidden.
numWaypoint: TGT STPT: the steerpoint the attack is planned on, 1 to 25 (HADB plans from a VRP only and needs no IP). A new mission or flight sets it once to your first strike steerpoint; after that it is yours.
lblWaypoint: TGT STPT: the steerpoint the attack is planned on, 1 to 25 (HADB plans from a VRP only and needs no IP). A new mission or flight sets it once to your first strike steerpoint; after that it is yours.
lblNewCoordinate: HADB plans from a VRP only, so it has no IP: these lines stay hidden.
lblTarget: The target's latitude and longitude (degrees, minutes), from the TGT STPT's position. Hidden while the theater is not known or the steerpoint has no position.
lblExtraInfoHide: Extra Info knob: Show puts the Extra Info panel under the sliders (TAS, MAP, bomb range, aim-off); Hide puts the Wheel panel there instead. Click the knob to turn it.
lblExtraInfoShow: Extra Info knob: Show puts the Extra Info panel under the sliders (TAS, MAP, bomb range, aim-off); Hide puts the Wheel panel there instead. Click the knob to turn it.
lblExtraInfo: Extra Info knob: Show puts the Extra Info panel under the sliders (TAS, MAP, bomb range, aim-off); Hide puts the Wheel panel there instead. Click the knob to turn it.
pnlHighDrag: High Drag: a retarded bomb (fins or a ballute open after release): it falls shorter and steeper than a slick one. Click the Bomb knob to choose it.
pnlLowDrag: Low Drag: a slick bomb, which carries further after release. Click the Bomb knob to choose it.
lblLowDrag: Low Drag: a slick bomb, which carries further after release. Click the Bomb knob to choose it.
lblHighDrag: High Drag: a retarded bomb (fins or a ballute open after release): it falls shorter and steeper than a slick one. Click the Bomb knob to choose it.
lblBomb: Bomb knob: Low Drag for a slick bomb (Mk-82 and alike), High Drag for a retarded one (Snakeye fins or an AIR ballute). It sets the bomb's range. Click the knob to turn it.
pnlBomb_Up: Bomb knob: Low Drag for a slick bomb (Mk-82 and alike), High Drag for a retarded one (Snakeye fins or an AIR ballute). It sets the bomb's range. Click the knob to turn it.
pnlBomb_Down: Bomb knob: Low Drag for a slick bomb (Mk-82 and alike), High Drag for a retarded one (Snakeye fins or an AIR ballute). It sets the bomb's range. Click the knob to turn it.
pnlExtraInfo_Up: Extra Info knob: Show puts the Extra Info panel under the sliders (TAS, MAP, bomb range, aim-off); Hide puts the Wheel panel there instead. Click the knob to turn it.
pnlExtraInfo_Down: Extra Info knob: Show puts the Extra Info panel under the sliders (TAS, MAP, bomb range, aim-off); Hide puts the Wheel panel there instead. Click the knob to turn it.
